identity.title: List of Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl chapters

leadText: This is a list of chapters of the manga created by 坂井 孝行 Sakai Takayuki. Altogether, there are 29 chapters. Currently, the Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl manga has not been translated into English by either VIZ Media or Chuang Yi.
